claim: TD Bank, N.A. total assets US$507B as of 2026-06-30
finding: US$507B is impossible under the US$434B OCC asset cap. TD's own Q4 FY2025 release gives combined U.S. Bank (TD Bank, N.A. + TD Bank USA, N.A.) assets of ~US$382B at Oct 31 2025 (US$388B on the consent-order measure at Sep 30 2025). American Banker (Aug 28 2025) reports US$386B, down US$48B since the cap.
resolution: total_assets_usd_billions 382 (combined U.S. Bank, Oct 31 2025; US$388B at Sep 30 2025 on the consent-order measure; cap US$434B)

claim: A TD Visa Debit Card is required for fast (within-minutes) Zelle delivery, else standard ACH 1-3 days
finding: The fee schedule lists the requirements for within-minutes delivery (Online Banking profile, U.S. address, unique mobile and email, ACH-enabled account, recipient enrolled) and does not mention a debit card. The Academy send demo (content/20, read live) gives the condition as both parties enrolled and the sender's instant limits not exceeded.
resolution: Within minutes when both parties are enrolled and the sender's instant limits are not exceeded; otherwise Next Day / Three Day ACH; account-number recipients 1-3 business days.

target: TD-J03/INITIATE/4 + exception 'Payer uses standalone Zelle app'
claim: Standalone Zelle app users cannot pay businesses
finding: The standalone Zelle app was shut down on April 1 2025. Its users had to re-enroll through their own bank's app, so the 'standalone app user' case no longer exists. The claim rests on S044, the older SMB FAQ PDF.
resolution: J03 INITIATE/4: payer uses Zelle inside their own bank's app or online banking (standalone Zelle app discontinued Apr 1 2025). The exception path is replaced by 'Payer's bank not a Zelle participant'.

claim: Help Center FAQ answer pages and TD Digital Academy demos are broken/unplayable, leaving no public step-by-step documentation
finding: Reviewer re-ran the Help Center knowledge base from td.com today: KB 2624, 2680, 2215, 3066 and 2315 return full answers. The Academy demos content/20 and content/171 load and expose every step. The gap-fill captured them (S901-S927), but the weakness still carries the first-wave wording.
resolution: Weakness replaced with the stale/contradictory-content wording in TD-C004.

claim: No published scam interstitial, in-app scam reporting, or scam-reimbursement policy beyond the generic line; three different phone numbers for Zelle issues
finding: Partly contradicted. A Security Reminder interstitial ('Only send to people you trust...') with a mandatory acknowledgment checkbox appears in the live Academy send demo, and the chapter lists it as a strength. The rest holds: no in-app scam reporting and no policy beyond 'Qualifying imposter scams may be eligible for reimbursement' (live business page). The three Zelle numbers are confirmed: 1-888-751-9000 on the business page, 1-800-493-7562 in the SMB FAQ PDF and 888-388-0406 in Academy content/153.
resolution: 'Only a static Security Reminder interstitial (mandatory checkbox); no in-app scam reporting; no published scam-reimbursement policy beyond "qualifying imposter scams may be eligible"; three different phone numbers for Zelle issues.'

claim: Consumer wires (domestic and international) are branch-only per third-party guides
finding: International consumer wires are in-person only. TD's own Foreign Exchange page and KB 2624 say so, so the evidence level can be CONFIRMED_BANK. For domestic, TD's live KB 2624 (re-queried today) says 'Currently TD Bank only offers domestic wire transfers in Online Banking', while KB 1398 says to visit a store. 'Branch-only' for domestic is therefore not established, and the evidence should not rest on third-party guides.
resolution: International: in person only (CONFIRMED_BANK). Domestic: TD's KB is contradictory (2624 vs 1398); status left in open questions pending a logged-in check.

claim: Verification method (trial deposits vs. instant) not disclosed publicly
finding: Disclosed publicly. Academy content/171 (read live) offers automatic verification with the external bank's online-banking username and password, or two small deposits. KB 3066 documents trial deposits under $10 within 2 business days. The product-level text and TD-J04 already say this, but the sub-product description and the open question were not updated.
resolution: TD-P02-S02 description updated; open question resolved.

claim: Zelle QR availability is contradicted on TD pages ('availability conflicting')
finding: The KB (3056-3060) and the Academy (161/162) confirm QR scan-to-pay and 'My Code' are live in the TD app, and the SMB Online Banking and Business Payment Suite pages market QR. The live zelle-for-business FAQ still says 'The Zelle® QR code feature is currently not available at TD Bank'. That is a stale line on the page, not an open question about the feature.
resolution: QR live (CONFIRMED_BANK); stale FAQ line noted as a content-quality issue; open question resolved.

finding: Read from the App Store version-history DOM (built-in browser): fund-availability estimates first appear in 26.3.2 (Jan 25 2026), not 26.3 or 26.4.4. 26.3 (Jan 14 2026) is the 24-months-of-transactions release. Spanish under 'Language preference' first appears in 26.4.5 (Feb 24 2026), not 26.5. SMB domestic wires with saved recipients first appear in 26.1.1 (Nov 5 2025); 25.12 (Oct 22 2025) carried the Bill Pay/Payment Center notes. Confirmed as correct: Disputes Center 26.7.3 (Jun 2 2026), SMB wire activity 26.6.1 (Apr 22 2026), Zelle limits 26.10.1 (Aug 5 2026), direct deposit 26.11.0 (Sep 16 2026).
resolution: Fund-availability estimates 26.3.2 (2026-01-25); Spanish 26.4.5 (2026-02-24); SMB domestic wires 26.1.1 (2025-11-05).

finding: App releases 25.11 (Sep 16 2025), 25.11.2 (Sep 28 2025) and 25.12 (Oct 22 2025) carry 'Updated features that allow seamless transitions while using Bill Pay' and a Payment Center redesign. The chapter lists the redesign but not the Bill Pay transition. It may signal a Bill Pay platform or vendor migration; no TD page confirms one, and tdbank.com/billpay shows no migration notice.
resolution: Add the recent change as quoted; add an open question on whether Bill Pay migrated platforms.

claim: Late or misapplied payment: Bill Pay guarantee not published
finding: Contradicted inside the chapter. The step's own friction field and the TD-J07 exception path cite the OBSA Bill Payment Service Guarantee (up to $50 in late charges if notified within 60 days of the Scheduled Payment Date). The action text was not updated, and the step cites S012 (fee schedule) rather than the OBSA.
resolution: J07 EXCEPTION/8 action reworded; sources S936, S012.

claim: External 'Instant Transfers' run over the ACCEL/Exchange debit network rather than RTP/FedNow
finding: The June 2026 terms define 'Payment Network' generically as 'a debit or credit network (such as the ACH Network or ACCEL / Exchange payment network)'. ACCEL/Exchange is an example in a definition, not a statement that Instant Transfers use it. The terms never mention RTP, FedNow or Visa Direct, and the chapter itself says live UI availability is unverified. Labelling this a differentiator overstates the evidence.
resolution: Remove the differentiator. Wording: terms define Instant Transfers over 'Payment Networks' (examples: ACH, ACCEL/Exchange); no RTP/FedNow/card reference; network and live availability unconfirmed (INFERRED).

claim: Business can send and request (limits $3,000/day, $15,000/month outbound)
finding: Incomplete, and the sources conflict. The June 2026 terms give Small Business 3-business-day outbound up to $3,000/day and $15,000/month, but within-minutes outbound up to $2,500/day and $10,000/month. TD's newer SMB Zelle FAQ PDF lists $2,500/$10,000 for both.
resolution: Within minutes $2,500/$10,000; 3-business-day $3,000/$15,000 per Jun 2026 terms (SMB FAQ PDF lists $2,500/$10,000 for both); inbound request $100,000.

claim: Commercial payables covered as Integrated Payables / ePayables / Embedded Banking
finding: TD's live payables page also lists Controlled Disbursement (plus full/partial account reconcilement and the TD Commercial Plus Card) as payables services. Controlled disbursement is a commercial check-disbursement money-movement service and is absent from the chapter.
resolution: Mention Controlled Disbursement and account reconcilement in the TD-P11 description (no new journey).

finding: The live Embedded Banking page (©2026) still carries the footnote 'Availability of wires through ERP expected Summer 2024'. Whether ERP wires actually launched cannot be confirmed from public pages.
resolution: Keep the claim, annotated 'footnote unchanged since 2024; live status unconfirmed'. A TD Embedded Banking user guide or an RM statement would settle it. Open question added.

claim: Feb 2026: TD Bank Group 'More Human' brand platform emphasising digital-first
finding: No source is cited, and this is an enterprise brand campaign, not a U.S. money-movement change. The reviewer found no TD U.S. money-movement page that references it.

claim: 2024 OCC consent order requiring supervisory approval for new products constrains the roadmap
finding: Not found in the OCC press release (S028), which mentions only a growth restriction. TD's own Q4 FY2025 release does state that the U.S. Bank is 'subject to OCC supervisory approval processes for any additions of new bank products' until the OCC accepts its AML program. The claim is right but should cite S031 as CONFIRMED_BANK.
resolution: Keep the wording; source list [S009, S031].

claim: Open questions still list items the gap-fill resolved (QR availability; external verification method)
finding: Both are resolved by S905/S912 and S906/S902 (see TD-C007 and TD-C008). The coverage self-assessment pages_blocked list also still includes Help Center and Academy URLs that now render.
resolution: Mark resolved: QR availability; external verification method.

claim: Customer learns wires are a store service; third-party guides state online wires are not available to personal customers
finding: The international in-person rule is CONFIRMED_BANK (Foreign Exchange page and KB 2624/2692), and the domestic online question is contradicted by TD's own KB. Neither should rest on Wise or GOBankingRates.
resolution: J10 DISCOVER/1 reworded; evidence CONFIRMED_BANK; sources S932, S902.
